_comment: Spell NAMES (as they appear in mythicsim-forever-engine/data/spells.jsonl) that Forte_Hunter tracks. gen_spell_data.py resolves each to its highest-rank spell ID + current duration/cooldown data. Names with no match in a given build are reported by the generator, not silently dropped -- re-check them after a mythicsim-forever-engine pull (Forever's Hunter talent tree was reworked: 14 new/26 reworked/11 unchanged of 51 talents per wowforeverguides.com, so some abilities may be talent-gated, renamed, or genuinely new and need adding here).
